Morpheus AI vs Qevlar: Key Differences & Pricing (2026)

The critical difference: Morpheus triages up to 95% of alerts at L2+ depth in under 2 minutes, generates playbooks from live evidence, runs across 800+ integrated tools, and executes the four autonomy tiers under one audit trail. Qevlar produces a triage verdict. Someone else must orchestrate and remediate.

Qevlar’s commercial-LLM wrapper covers alert triage only. Morpheus delivers investigation, orchestration, and remediation in one platform, reducing time-to-remediation from hours to minutes and eliminating the second-vendor SOAR project.
Qevlar produces verdicts, not response plans. Analysts must read the verdict and decide what to do next, or hand off to pre-built SOAR playbooks.
Qevlar plus a SOAR platform plus integration glue equals three or more vendors, three training cycles, and three times the maintenance burden.

Qevlar wraps a general-purpose model with prompt engineering. Morpheus runs on the Cybersecurity Triage Reasoning Graph, built over 24 months by 60 security specialists. The graph is the moat. The LLM is interchangeable.

After remediation, Morpheus verifies the fix worked. If not, it re-executes automatically. This closed-loop approach delivers 80% MTTR improvement and prevents adversaries from bouncing back. Qevlar stops at the triage verdict.
